# `timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse`

Suggests dedicated timeout combinators instead of catching TimeoutError immediately after Effect.timeout

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377127` |
| Language Service name | `timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/timeout-catch-tag-to-timeout-or-else` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const fetchQuote: Effect.Effect<string>

export const quote = fetchQuote.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("5 seconds"),
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeed("cached quote"))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(timeout-catch-tag-to-timeout-or-else): Use `Effect.timeoutOrElse` to handle this timeout directly.
*/
)

export const maybeQuote = fetchQuote.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("5 seconds"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(timeout-catch-tag-to-timeout-or-else): Use `Effect.timeoutOption` to handle this timeout directly.
*/
)
```
